scope: Headed manual production-UI review of one DOCX-to-text flow; this is not a process-tree memory certification or comprehensive document-route audit.
server: Production Wrangler build on localhost:3110 with production headers
browserMethod: Headed Playwright CLI, real fixture selection, production document worker, test-mode isolated OPFS destination

observedBeforeConversion.destinationLimitationDisclosure: Main document text only; formatting, images, tables, hyperlinks, comments, headers, footers, notes, and document properties are not represented in plain text.
observedBeforeConversion.inspectionGap: The source panel supplied type/size/MIME but no bounded DOCX structural inspection before conversion. Its generic fallback incorrectly referred to container streams and codecs; the UI copy was corrected to describe local validation and destination limitations without implying media semantics.
